'''{{lang|it|Zuppa toscana}}''' ({{literally|Tuscan soup}}), also known in Italy as '''{{lang|it|minestra di pane}}''' ({{literally|[[bread soup]]}}), is a [[soup]] from the region of [[Tuscany]], northern Italy. While there are many variations, its most common ingredients are [[Kidney bean#Classification|cannellini beans]], [[potato]]es, and [[kale]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Burros |first=Marian |date=1992-11-25 |title=Eating Well |url=https://www.nytimes.com/1992/11/25/garden/eating-well.html |access-date=2023-11-25 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=MSN |url=https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/other/zuppa-toscana-soup-recipe/vi-AA1J2WY3 |access-date=2025-08-10 |website=www.msn.com}}</ref>
